name: Aquatech Systems (Asia) Pvt. Ltd.
india_angle: Aquatech has a significant presence in India through its subsidiary, Aquatech Systems (Asia) Pvt. Ltd.
summary: Aquatech Systems (Asia) Pvt. Ltd. provides advanced water and process technology solutions crucial for semiconductor manufacturing facilities. Their expertise in water reuse, desalination, and zero liquid discharge helps fabs and foundries reduce water risk and achieve sustainability goals.
